title: Define Vault bootstrap, audit, and recovery evidence contract
expected_outcome: A non-secret, fail-closed operator contract defines the ordered Vault bootstrap boundary and the audit/snapshot/restore evidence required before release credentials can be enabled.
constraints: Do not initialize, unseal, configure, or access a live Vault.
Do not deploy, publish, merge, alter secrets, access AWS, or access production.
Do not store root, recovery, unseal, AWS, Vault, or certificate material in Git, CI, or Terraform state.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

acceptance_checks: reuse known bootstrap and recovery gaps
delegations.escalation_trigger: a live Vault or secret is required
a command or artifact would initialize, configure, or access Vault or other cloud resources

validation: existing Vault GitOps and release contracts
